title: Repair Hours Net of Diagnosis on a Repeat Repair Estimate — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders repeat repair estimate, the repair hours follow the diagnosis and the earlier repair's labor.

| Diagnostic fee hours | Customer-pay labor charges on the earlier repair's line | Repair hours |
|---|---|---|
| At least 1 hour | A single labor charge | that charge's hours less the diagnostic hours, because the diagnosis already covered the teardown |
| Any | Two or more labor charges | the sum of their hours less the diagnostic hours |
| Below 1 hour | A single labor charge | the hours of the earlier repair's latest labor charge |

The diagnostic hours are the hours on the latest diagnostic fee charged on the account; the earlier repair's line is the repair order and concern line of the latest customer-pay parts charge on the same vehicle.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- Diagnosis 1.0 hour; one labor charge of 4.5 hours — 3.5 hours.
- Diagnosis 0.5 hour; two labor charges of 2.0 and 1.6 hours — 3.1 hours.
- Diagnosis 0.5 hour; one labor charge of 4.5 hours — 4.5 hours.
